route_sets.name: Avery Library visit
route_sets.note: Two separate permissions. Campus: ID Only, so bring your CUID, or the QR code from guest or alumni registration. Library: CUID access; without a CUID, arrange your visit with Avery (avery@library.columbia.edu) before you come. The library cannot give campus access.
